To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Data MPI is a more balanced and more efficient big data application framework system than Hadoop.
the performance of a big data system is influenced by the application framework software system, and that the Data MPI based system has better performance than the Hadoop based system.

Amdahl's law can be used as a guideline to evaluate big data system performance, that Data MPI based systems are more balanced and have higher performance, that the CPU speed, memory capacity, and I/O rate are the three main metrics that influence the performance and balance of big data systems, and that the performance of big data systems can be improved by increasing the CPU speed, increasing the memory capacity, or increasing the I/O rate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How does Amdahl's law work in big data systems?
the influence of the application framework on system performance and balance, and provides a new way to evaluate and compare different big data application frameworks.
the application of Amdahl’s second law in evaluating the performance of big data application framework systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Data MPI framework is better suited than Hadoop for big data applications that require high performance and balance.
Amdahl's law is a useful guideline for the performance and balance evaluation of big data application framework systems.
the performance and balance of a big data system can be improved by using Data MPI instead of Hadoop as the application framework.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the performance and balance of a big data system is determined by its software framework, which is the most critical component in the system, and that Amdahl's law is a good tool for evaluating and optimizing the software framework.
the performance of a Hadoop based big data system is mainly determined by CPU speed, while that of a Data MPI based system is determined by memory capacity and I/O rate.
Data MPI is a better application framework for big data systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Amdahl's law can be a useful tool for the design, evaluation, and comparison of big data application frameworks.
Amdahl's law can be used to analyze and optimize software systems.
Amdahl's law can be used for performance characterization of application framework software systems.
